name: Suno
summary: Suno makes an AI music generator that creates full songs, with vocals, from a text prompt.
overview: Suno develops AI models that generate complete songs, including vocals and instruments, from text prompts.
bull_case: Suno has the strongest consumer brand in AI music and a growing base of paying users.
bear_case: Copyright disputes with labels and competition from Google and others could limit growth.

intelligence.description: Suno develops AI models that generate complete songs, including vocals and instruments, from text prompts.
company: Suno was founded in 2022 by Mikey Shulman and colleagues, and its app lets anyone create full songs with vocals from a short text description. It has become the best-known AI music product, and has faced copyright lawsuits from major record labels.
In June 2026 Suno raised $400 million at a $5.4 billion valuation, more than double its $2.45 billion valuation from November 2025.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Suno is the leading test of AI-generated music as a consumer product and of how the music industry and AI companies settle copyright disputes.

changed.text: Major record labels sue Suno over copyright.

takeaways: The valuation more than doubled in about seven months.
Copyright issues remain the key risk.
Big tech firms are building competing music models.
